note: Outer ring only; hub, rotor and exact assembly mass not measured. KV bus-domain conversion is not directly the phase-q BEMF coefficient.

center_of_mass_model.assumptions: Three equal wheel assemblies centered on faces 2(-X),3(Y),6(-Z), selected edge parallel Y at +X/-Z; all remaining mass at geometric center. This is a model, not a measured neutral reference.
center_of_mass_model.limitation: Board mass, motor positions, inner hubs, frame and cable forces can change this substantially; do not directly program these model angles as verified balance zero.
